input.quote: Except for payment obligations hereunder, neither party is responsible to fulfill its obligations to the extent due to causes beyond its control.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant anywhere, even though IBM hosts our e-business environment and processes our data — walk-away territory for a data-processing vendor. Redline inserts a short insurance paragraph (CGL, E&O, cyber, workers' compensation, certificates on request) in the general terms.

input.quote: Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage.
input.rationale: The Base Terms impose no minimum purchase, take-or-pay or shortfall commitment; charges follow the Services ordered under Order Forms and Service Option Attachments. No volume restriction binds our usage, so no redline is needed (commercial commitments in Order Forms should be checked when issued).

input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable.
input.rationale: Section 3.5 deals only with our payment obligations; the Agreement says nothing about transition assistance, return or export of our Content and data, or deletion — unacceptable in a hosting deal. Redline inserts six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, data return in machine-readable form within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.
